evidence_required: two distinct reasons (confounding/time variation; information value vs cost/risk).

marking.criterion: Reason 1: confounding and time variation; the before/after of a rollback mixes it with everything else that changed
Reason 2: low information per cost and risk compared with offline partitions (one leaf, slow, drains/reboots)
Notes that the rollback destroys the natural experiment (half upgraded, half not)

title: Why a diagnostic rollback is a poor test
